messages.subject: stat_smooth error in shiny server
parts:
stat_smooth code works in RStudio but gives an error in Shiny Server

server code:
p <- ggplot(data = bldData) +
          geom_point(data = bldData, aes(x = var, y = Y), colour = 'red', size = 5) +
       stat_smooth(data=bldData, method = "lm", aes(x=var,y=Y),
         formula = y ~ x, colour="blue",size = 1, se=FALSE)
    print(p)

error message:
geom_smooth: Only one unique x value each group.Maybe you want aes(group = 1)?
